newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Technologies sells dental unit.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Technologies sells dental unit.

text.p: Sunrise Technologies International Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to sell its dental division to Lares Research for $7 million.
Lares will pay a combination of cash, notes, and stock warrants. Upon closing of the deal, expected in 90 days, Lares will pay Sunrise $5 million.
Closing of the deal is subject to shareholder approvals and Lares' raising equity capital to fund the payment.
The Sunrise Technologies dental division makes MicroPrep, an air abrasion system for cavity preparation, and other dental products.
Sunrise said it will use the funds as capital to grow its eye care business outside the U.S. as well as funding ongoing clinical studies.
